description: ... [I] was thrilled to learn that [Darren] is running for the Utah House of Representatives... He’s intelligent, wise, thoughtful, and has strong moral character. He’s been an example to me... on how to make educated, well thought out decisions. In a representative form of government I can’t think of anyone better to represent me and my family.
title: David Huff - Darren Croft for Utah House District 41
